turn to some developments regarding the

Ukrainian forces have learned how to

Analysts also point out a distinctive

More than 1,000 Russian soldiers have

The General Staff of Ukraine has

failures of the Russian army have been

volunteered to give an interview. This

individual voluntarily agreed to
participate in interviews with Ukraine.
The Ukrainian reporter asked, "Under
what circumstances did the Ukrainian
military take you as a prisoner of war?
" This person replied, "We were
stationed in a forest strip where
fighting had been going on for about
two weeks." You advanced into that area
, and throughout those two weeks, a war

You have the choice of either dying or
voluntarily surrendering. In my
specific case, I chose to surrender. In
other words, I chose life and
voluntarily surrendered. The young man
standing with me did not surrender; he
was killed in action. He did not want

had known each other there for about 5

ordered us to hold our ground until the
end. Of course, I cannot use profanity,
but they threatened that we would be
executed if we surrendered. something
like that, a form of intimidation. At
the time I was captured, which was
October 9th, I hadn't eaten for 5 days,

pale. A young man asked me, "Are you an
addict?" I replied, "No." He asked
again, "Why are your lips so pale?" I
said, "I haven't had anything to eat or
drink for five days." He then said, "
Hang in there, I'll get you some food
in a bit." And just a few hours later,
he actually gave me a chocolate bar and
poured me a cup of hot coffee. That was
when I understood I could relax a bit,
and that was it. From then on, there
was absolutely no cruel treatment
toward me. The Ukrainian reporter asked

Russian soldier replied, "At that time,
I was faced with a choice: either go to

operation. Because when I was a Russian

," No, not at all. Those with a V code,
